inference: The missing generated CR text is a concrete observer-actuation defect relative to the canonical dispatch and shared-handler requirement. proposed_observation: Passive capture listeners on the selected original summary record actual keydown/keypress/keyup/click fields and isTrusted; a passive toggle observer records the original details state. No preventDefault, handler replacement, element.click(), direct open assignment or synthetic DOM dispatchEvent.
